entity_raw.definition_raw:
You have learned the treacherous spells employed by the fey.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, Spellcraft 1 rank, ability to cast druid spells.

Benefit(s): Add the following spells to your druid spell list at the indicated levels: 0—dancing lights, 1st—lesser confusion, 2nd—charm person, 3rd—invisibility, 4th—bestow curse, 5th—charm monster, 6th—major curse, 7th—cloak of dreams, 8th—insanity, 9th—irresistible dance.
